name: teacher_pairwise_specialists_fold0_seed42_20261024
representation: Only original frozen fold0 ResNet2048 cached features; original4043train,718inner,1176outer and1709known-source rows.
pair_discovery: StratifiedGroupKFold3 shuffle seed42 within original train. Each temporary eight-way logistic fits its own fit-part StandardScaler; fit rows have uniform weight4043/n_fit. Stitch train-head held decisions, compute symmetric balanced confusion .5*(CM[a,b]/support[a]+CM[b,a]/support[b]). For each Lupus/Psoriasis/Tinea select one highest non-cancer rival, then total pair confusion count, then lowest label index. Skip zero-confusion targets; deduplicate sorted pairs. Lock pairs before reading inner labels/predictions.
comparison: One final eight-way multinomial logistic on all4043train versus one binary logistic per discovered pair on pair train rows only. Final scaler fits all4043train and is shared, C=.001 same, binary uniform sample weight4043/n_pair so total loss-weight mass equals eight-way control. No class balancing, auxiliary images or new backbone. Binary targets keep original label indices.
control: Use sigmoid(logit_b-logit_a) from eight-way head for each pair. Both arms have the same binary score arity, pair endpoints, >=.8 threshold and conflict policy. The conditional control discards outside-pair evidence; scores are not calibrated clinical confidence.
routing: Only current predictions belonging to a discovered pair may change to its other endpoint with confidence>=.8. Gather switch proposals from all applicable pairs against original current prediction. Exactly one unique destination switches; conflicting destinations abstain, keep votes do not veto. No chaining. Cancer is excluded from every pair and its exact prediction mask is fixed.
selection: Fixed current/conditional-control/binary-pairs comparison on inner labels, strict existing per-weak Recall/F1,totalAccuracy/MacroF1,weakPrecision and otherRecall guards. Binary additionally MF>=control and meanweakF1 strictly above both control/current. Rank MF,meanweakRecall,Accuracy,ties current then control. Lock heads and choice before new outer/source inference. No C/pair/threshold grid using inner or outer.
scope: Onefold exploratory pilot, not a new5937 score. If selected, full-fivefold confirmation needs a separately frozen protocol; no automatic claim of global improvement.
limitations: Exploratory development: allouter/inner previously studied, not a fresh independent clinical test.
CNN parent checkpoints and baseline weights previously used fullinner for selection; nested meta-fitting does not undo inherited exposure or makeCNNvalidation fully nested.
Gate labels/probabilities conditional on decisive disagreements, not clinically calibrated disease probabilities.
Bothwrong rows carry zero relativeAccuracy benefit but changingwronglabels can alter MacroF1/precision; heldguards evaluate allrows.
Few decisive examples and shift from nestedhalf-fit stack to2/3fit and finalfullinner stack confidence. OneCNNseed; groups not verifiedpatients.
Cancer mask preserves existing false positives and negatives. No new data, relabeling, API or Word change.
Borrow gating/stacking ideas only; not a reproduction of jointlytrained mixturesofexperts. Fixedthreshold2/3 is an engineering prior, not selected using outcomes.
This is an original localutility heuristic inspired by cost-sensitive Fmeasure literature, not a reproduction or globally optimalF1algorithm.
Single-switch deltas about originalCM are not additive when multiple switches occur; optimizing weighted loss does not guarantee globalMacroF1 or weakF1 improvement.
Utility targets include training labels and CM only inside fitrole. Runtime uses modeloutputs only. Weighted gate scores are not diseaseprobabilities.
Fixedthreshold2/3 enforces conservative weighted odds; it was not tuned. Different utility signs/rowpopulation are part of the objectivechange, while scaler/totalweightmass are heldfixed.
Prior validation-selected gate improved development aggregates slightly but decreased someweakF1/sourceMF. Newresults remain exploratory on repeatedly studied images.
This is a local activation ablation, not a reproduction of a dermatology paper or a guaranteed cure for errors shared by all parents.
The old CNN features were fitted on original train and selected using inner labels. Specialist20checkpoint selection adds development exposure; no fresh independent test.
Identity arm is linear in input but has factorized nonconvex optimization, not an optimizer-matched replication of old one-layer LBFGS.
Same .8 threshold isolates activation but score distributions may differ; no disease calibration claim.
Inner currentgate crossfit scores and outer finalgate scores have different fit sizes. Five CNNfolds and oneheadseed are not multiseed validation.
No new source images or source-generalization conclusion from this experiment alone.
One prechosen dropout probability and 20-epoch budget test this configuration only; rejection does not show all dropout methods are ineffective.
Dropout may change score scale and accepted switches at fixed 0.8; no probability calibration or threshold adjustment is inferred.
Stochastic dropout training loss is not comparable to deterministic control training loss. Use eval-mode diagnostics for the head generalization gap.
No new source evaluation is implied. If selected policy is unchanged, only that unchanged policy inherits its previous descriptive transfer results.
Fold0 inner contains no SCIN Lupus. This pilot cannot establish improved SCIN Lupus or stability across folds/seeds.
Raw latent features may retain cues lost in final probabilities, but complementary information or improved disease accuracy is a hypothesis, not a guarantee.
One original CNN seed, previously studied inner/outer/source labels. No fresh independent clinical test.
Feature dimension and number of head coefficients increase; energy matching controls overall feature scale but not feature correlations or all forms of regularization.
The class selector has 256 candidate maps versus4 shared maps; grouped cross-fitting reduces but cannot remove selection overfit in only718 inner images.
Frozen parents already used inner labels for epoch choice; meta-held head selection is not full nested CNN retraining.
Actions depend on predicted classes, never true diagnoses. Preserving the cancer mask also preserves all previous cancer errors.
No deployment or new global5937 score from this single-fold pilot.
Train-head held folds share a CNN already trained on all original train rows. They only discover pairs; they are not independent end-to-end OOF performance.
Pair heads have two targets and fewer parameters than the full eight-way head. Matching total sample-weight mass does not match feature covariance, class priors or every form of regularization.
A two-way task may force confident wrong choices for images belonging to another disease. Endpoint routing, conflict abstention and validation guards can limit, not eliminate, this risk.
All roles are historically inspected; one seed/fold and no new patient test. Preserving the Cancer mask preserves its prior errors.
